text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things have been terribly busy lately.
It's only natural, considering I'm in charge of an Umamusume competing in the Twinkle Series, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fair amount of dust had gathered in the corners and such.
...That said, I wasn't in the mood to clean right now,
so I just left the room and headed to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...!
You there! Pardon the sudden interruption, but do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As Air Groove's trainer,
I have high expectations of you, and something important to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall be blunt.
Is your room 'worth cleaning'?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Your confusion is only natural. But time is of the essence.
I apologize, but please answer me concisely."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I ask you once more.
Is your room 'worth cleaning'?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A stroke of luck! The surface area is just right,
balancing a sense of accomplishment with a realistically achievable scope...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, it belongs to someone trustworthy!
Truly one-of-a-kind! You couldn't ask for better conditions!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alright, 5 minutes. Within 5 minutes,
I'll bring Air Groove and head to your room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the objective is to "clean" your room!
Please wait in your quarters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without understanding why, I hurried straight back to the room
and waited just as Symboli Rudolf told me to.
Then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The President told me I could clean here.
...I would like to begin right away, if that is alright with you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No need to be formal. ...This is not charity towards you.
This is an act driven purely by my own personal circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that said, Air Groove pulled a cloth out of thin air and silently began wiping down a corner of the room...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, quite a thick layer of dust has gathered.
I will take you all on...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"……I doubt I need to remind you, but...
regarding what happened today, keep it strictly between us."
choice_data_list: Could you tell me what happened now?
Could you tell me what happened now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I left things under-explained, didn't I?
Well, to be frank with you—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The student council has had its hands full with several troublesome matters these past few days.
On top of that, they've mostly been mentally draining rather than physical—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Simply put,
Air Groove had been subjected to a considerable amount of stress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I called on you
to help you blow off all that pent-up stress.
choice_data_list: Cleaning is a way to relieve stress...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Black mold on the sash that won't come off just by wiping, is it...?
Heh... hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think I would show you mercy?
Naturally, I have prepared it... the baking soda, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard she was blowing off steam and took a look;
she certainly seemed to be having fun. ...Uncannily so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I first saw it, I was a bit... well, surprised too.
It seems that doesn't happen unless one goes entirely off the deep end, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"At that time, she was cleaning dust from every single
crevice in the student council room's flooring.
...It was quite a sight to behold."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, cleaning yields visible results, so it is easy to gain a sense of accomplishment from it, but... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, her memory of what she does
while cleaning is rather fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my right-hand's honor, I'll say it again:
not a word of this to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, just standing around like this is
a waste of time. So—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ho! Cleaning is physical labor too, after all.
A fine idea indeed. Allow me to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With Symboli Rudolf's help, I decided to head out to buy some tea snacks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to catch my breath.
Thank you for your concern, President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have been of great help as well.
By the way—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Did I say anything strange
while I was cleaning?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While exchanging glances with Symboli Rudolf, I shook my head repeatedly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You're going to talk to her in that state?!
N-No, it's a forward-thinking idea, but still...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh. In other words, you wish to join my army.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
You, take hold of that baking soda water!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And—President!
You're that toothbrush over there!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: O-Oh?! Me too...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...While having high-pressure orders barked at me,
I spent a 'fun' (?) time cleaning."
